arguments.subject: Re: $680 tenant repair charge for 2025 sink-cabinet work
arguments.body:
Hello South Slope Management,

The 2025 sink-cabinet work did not address an active plumbing leak caused inside our apartment. The inspection found condensation on an uninsulated cold-water riser; the supply, drain, trap, wall, and electrical components showed no leak.

The building repair was completed by insulating the riser, drying the cavity, and installing a removable moisture-resistant back panel. Final moisture readings were 8–9% against an 8% control; supply, drain, trap, and filled-basin tests were dry, the musty odor was gone, and the cabinet was returned to normal storage use. Management previously confirmed that this was a building repair with a $0 household charge. Devika and I owe $0 for it.

The December 14 portal showed a $0.00 rent balance and no late fee. Please remove the unsupported $680 tenant charge, correct the ledger, and send us the corrected ledger and written confirmation of the household balance. Please also confirm that no late fee or other balance will result from this disputed charge.

Thank you,
Alex
